digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge preview and reconcile command parser
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must run a single ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit one manifest containing arbitrated plan entries plus exact field-level drift detail from that same pass without invoking or re-implementing reconcile-check.
Canonical bridge preview must operate lock-free: it acquires, purges, steals, and writes no pass lock, and all collateral repository and lock state remain unchanged.
Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check must retain its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, diagnostic JSON artifact, output, and exit behavior.

Argparse must use allow_abbrev=False so abbreviated or unknown options exit with invocation error 2 before any reads, locks, or mutations, while documented legacy options like --mode dry-run remain valid.
Canonical bridge preview and canonical bridge sync must emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope; canonical uncapped live must retain a manifest with exact applied/failed tally.
Legacy uncapped LIVE callers through CLI, direct engine, library, MCP, older workflows, and external helpers must retain the historical tally/no-retained-manifest contract unchanged.
